text: Quick recap. Apis cerana is Nepal's hive bee, and the bee space makes the movable frame hive work. Silkworms pass five instars and four moults. Composite fish culture puts six carps in six niches. The buffalo gives most of our milk. Koch's postulates prove a microbe causes a disease, and the Ziehl Neelsen stain shows tuberculosis as red rods. Vaccines give active immunity, antibiotics act only on bacteria, and microbes also make our curd and our biogas.
